title: Updraft
tagline: Bounce higher. Never look down.
description: An endless climb up crumbling platforms. Every bounce takes you higher. The only way to lose is to fall.

title: Bigger Fish
tagline: Mass is speed, spent.
description: Eat to grow in a pond far bigger than the screen. Growing slows you down, so the fish you want most gets away unless you split. Surviving big is the score.

title: Number Crunch
tagline: Solve fast. Shoot faster.
description: Answers drift down the screen. Shoot the right one. A streak makes them harder, a few misses ease them back.

title: Keystroke
tagline: Type clean, not just quick.
description: A race you win on accuracy, not speed. Every key is tracked. The end screen shows which ones cost you. Needs a physical keyboard.

title: Sinkhole
tagline: Keep falling. Don't get caught.
description: A climbing game upside down. Drop through gaps in the hazards. Something rises underneath, and hesitating is what kills you.

title: Circuit Racer
tagline: Four circuits. Three rivals. One line.
description: Top-down racing on four circuits against a field of three, with a slipstream to work for and split times to chase. Pick your track, your race length and how hard the rivals push. Your fastest lap is the score.

title: Block Buster
tagline: Clear the board and the world changes.
description: A falling-shape puzzle that comes apart properly. Cleared cells drop on their own, so a stack with holes in it collapses into a chain. Empty the board and the whole world restyles.

title: Neon Drift Delivery
tagline: The clock is the fuel. Pass close.
description: A courier run through traffic that drives properly rather than getting in your way. Every delivery buys time and sends the next drop further out. Miss one and the run is over.

title: Skyhook
tagline: Speed is the only thing holding you up.
description: Swing between skyscrapers on a grappling hook. Reel in at the bottom of the arc to speed up, let go to keep every bit of it. The gaps widen the further you go.

title: Tower Stack
tagline: Every miss makes the next one harder.
description: Drop a sliding slab onto the one below. Whatever hangs over the edge is sheared off, and what is left is all you have to aim at next time. Misses cost width, not lives.

title: Gravity Flip
tagline: One button. Down is negotiable.
description: A precision runner with one control: which way is down. Rooms of spikes, walls and saws, dealt in escalating order, and a flip always costs the same four tiles of ground.

title: Ballast
tagline: Stack the hold. Keep her level.
description: Crates drop into a barge that floats. Where the weight lands tilts the hull, and a hull too far over ships water. Pack a row tight and it slides out of the hold.

title: Ember
tagline: One burner. Mind the walls.
description: A balloon drifting up a gorge at dusk. Hold the burner to rise, let go to sink, and commit early, because a balloon carries its momentum and cannot change its mind.

title: Rift Runner
tagline: Every portal changes the rules.
description: An endless runner: jump, slide, and dash through rift walls. Every portal rewrites the physics: how far you jump, how hard you fall, even which way is down. Every pattern is provably clearable.

title: Endless Mini Golf
tagline: Sink it under par. Bank the difference.
description: Crazy golf that never runs out. Putt under par and the spare strokes go in the bank; go over and they come out. Empty the bank and the round is over.

title: Winter Base Building
tagline: Wood burns. Wood builds. There is never enough.
description: Survive a winter forest one day at a time: gather wood, hunt, or raise the wall. The fire and the wolves both want more each week, and wood cannot do both jobs.

title: Tank Tactics
tagline: The wall is the second barrel.
description: Arena tanks with a ricochet you can aim. A shell that comes off a wall hits twice as hard, and dug-in tanks can only be reached with a bounce. Waves cleared is the score.

title: Colour Heist
tagline: The doors only open for what you are wearing.
description: Steal gems from a vault of coloured doors. A door only opens while you are its colour, and changing colour costs half a second you cannot spare. Gems stolen is the score.

title: Hangman
tagline: Every word can be reasoned out. That is the promise.
description: Hangman with the unfairness taken out: every word is proved solvable from what you can see. Six wrong guesses a word, and the words get stranger as you go.

title: Asteroid Salvage
tagline: Armour is not free. It is heavy.
description: Fly a field, collect salvage, spend it in the shop, fly a denser one. Armour is heavy, so every plate you bolt on slows the ship that has to dodge.

title: Beat Blocker
tagline: The music is made out of the chart.
description: Three lanes, one shield, a rising tempo. Block the falling attacks on the beat, where a hit is worth triple. The music is played from the chart, so the two can never drift apart.

title: Gravity Well
tagline: Burning is a decision. Falling is free.
description: Fly down an endless corridor of planets whose pull beats your engine. The dotted line ahead is exactly where you are going, and it stops where you would. Distance is the score.

title: Comet
tagline: Your tail is the weapon.
description: Survive an arena that keeps filling up. You trail fire behind you. Anything that touches it burns away, so every escape route is also a trap.

title: Tide
tagline: Fill a line. The biggest share takes it.
description: A board game with one rule: place a stone, and when a row or column fills, whoever holds most of it takes the line. Two to six players, one screen, one pad passed round.

title: Impostor Circle
tagline: One of you has a different word.
description: Everyone gets the same word except one person, and nobody is told who, including the impostor. Say one word each, then vote. Everyone is the impostor exactly once.

title: Wavelength Lite
tagline: One of you can see the spot. Say something useful.
description: A dial between two opposites. One player sees a hidden spot on it and gives a clue, no numbers, and everyone else takes a turn placing the pointer. Points for landing near the spot.
